A '''[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' found within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Biology and appearance==
A bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they possessed large, rounded heads.<ref name="TPM" />

==Species in the galaxy==
A young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] owned a statue of a member of this species in his home on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species could first be seen briefly via a statue in the background of {{Film|I}}.<ref name="TPM" />
